title: Northstar - RAID transition register
source: Fictional Northstar rehearsal record and supplied chronology
scope: Attachment relationship migration at the 6 November rehearsal cutoff
state: risk materialized; linked issue open; dependency acceptance unknown
decision_boundary: Investigate and retest the observed failure while actual authorities decide disposition, escalation and any prospective baseline change.

risk_scale.likelihood_basis: No assessed probability or agreed ordinal likelihood scale was supplied.
risk_scale.impact_basis: Relationship correctness and acceptance consequences are described directly.
risk_scale.score_warning: No score is calculated; materialization, open issue state and dependency variance drive attention.

items.title: Attachment identifiers may break relationships
items.statement: Inconsistent attachment identifiers may break ticket relationships.
items.objective: Preserve correct attachment relationships through migration
items.evidence: The 6 November rehearsal reproduces missing links; exact population and configuration are not supplied.
items.action: Link the observed population to M-I002 and specify any remaining uncertain populations or conditions.
items.closure_test: Observed failure remains in M-I002; remaining bounded uncertainty is retired only by applicable evidence or authorized disposition.
items.transition: M-I002 records the observed failure while M-R01 preserves the earlier warning and any residual uncertainty.

details.cause: Attachment identifiers may be inconsistent across source and target.
details.event: Ticket-to-attachment relationships do not survive migration.
details.effect: Migrated records lose required links and cannot meet acceptance.
details.response: Characterize the affected population and verify corrected mapping behavior.
details.contingency: Correct the mapping, retest the agreed population and escalate if credible recovery cannot support the baseline.

items.note: Materialized does not mean all populations are known or the historical risk should be renamed.

items.title: Lost attachment links observed
items.statement: Lost attachment links were observed in the 6 November rehearsal.
items.objective: Demonstrate correct relationships for the agreed migration population
items.owner: Chen coordinates; Beck supplier commitment to confirm
items.evidence: Missing links are reproduced; expected versus observed links, exact count, configuration and evidence-file reference are absent.
items.action: Capture expected and observed links, affected population, mapping version and reproduction conditions, then correct and retest.
items.closure_test: Corrected relationships are demonstrated for the agreed population with applicable evidence and business acceptance, or an authorized disposition is recorded.
items.transition: A supplier patch remains proposed until applicable retest and acceptance evidence exist.

details.observed_condition: The rehearsal reproduces missing attachment links.
details.consequence: Migrated tickets do not retain required relationships.
details.resolution: Correct the mapping and demonstrate correct relationships for the agreed population.
details.escalation: Escalate if credible correction, retest and accepted scope cannot support the current baseline.

items.note: Equal source and target counts do not prove relationship correctness.

items.title: Attachment mapping handoff
items.statement: The mapping was needed 2 November and forecast 4 November; actual accepted delivery is not supplied.
items.objective: Provide an accepted mapping before relationship correction and retest
items.evidence: Earlier need and forecast dates are supplied; actual delivery and receiver acceptance are not.
items.action: Recover the actual provider and receiver state and confirm the usable accepted mapping.
items.closure_test: The receiver accepts the specified mapping; delivery alone does not prove downstream relationship correctness.
items.transition: Late or unusable mapping remains linked to the issue without duplicating the same repair ownership.

details.usable_condition: Mapping is versioned, complete for the agreed population and usable for relationship correction.

items.note: Do not assume the earlier forecast became accepted delivery.

presentation.headline: Materialization creates a link, not a rename
presentation.lede: The prior risk, observed issue and required mapping retain separate evidence, owners and closure rules.
presentation.decision: Characterize the observed failure, recover the mapping acceptance state, correct and retest before any disposition.

analysis.method: Stable IDs preserve the earlier risk, current issue and dependency record while links explain their relationship.
analysis.classification_boundary: M-I002 contains observed failure evidence; M-R01 preserves the earlier uncertain event and any remaining bounded uncertainty.
analysis.scoring_boundary: No agreed scale or numeric assessment was supplied, so no probability-impact score is fabricated.
analysis.authority_boundary: Chen may coordinate; Beck's commitment, business acceptance and any change approval remain separate actual decisions.
analysis.closure_rule: A proposed patch or matching counts do not close the issue; applicable relationship evidence and required acceptance are needed.
